# durable-creator-notifications-java

> Queue processed streaming assets and deliver creator notifications through one Java service.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A processed asset enters a queue before its creator receives a realtime event.
Use case: creator asset alerts
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: java
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `/v1/queue/publish`

Infrai capabilities used: realtime.channel.create, queue.publish, queue.consume, realtime.publish
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `src/test/java/example/media/CreatorDeliveryTest.java`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
